snippet.title: The Settlers 3 (Siedler 3) - 1 Hour Relaxed No Commentary Gameplay - Romans
snippet.description:
The Settlers 3 used to be my absoulte favourite game. Being completely honest here - as a kid I only played the tutorial. I could just build up my settlement on my own time and did not have to fear any attacks (which serously stressed me out as a kid).

In this game we play as the Roman Empire and are up against our Egyptian neighbours. While facing some issues regarding the available space we manage to build up a good-running settlement, build up an army and attack ... And then we just sail away on a ship.

Enjoy this one hour of relaxed gameplay without commentary. You can just let it run on the side and watch all the settlers go on with their tasks. I tried not to move my screen too much and jsut let the game go on - because that is the real beauty of the settlers.

//Time stamps

The music and sounds of this game alone bring me back to my childhood. Playing this game again motivated me to do this channel. Computer games can give the so many nostalgic feelings and I plan to visit a lot of places of my childhood

If you also want to play The Settlers III you can buy the History Edition in the Ubisoft Store.
